semiconductor_relevance: Medium — UTRACS Inc. provides specialized flexing cables and assemblies crucial for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: UTRACS Inc. is a Value Added Reseller of W.L. Gore & Associates, focusing on high-performance flexing cables and assemblies for the semiconductor and OLED manufacturing sectors. They custom design and manufacture products like Gore Trackless Cables in Korea, addressing customer needs for improved flex life and dust control in automated manufacturing equipment.
capabilities: Dust control solutions for manufacturing equipment

regional_presence.Korea: UTRACS custom designs and manufactures its products in Korea, tailoring solutions for local semiconductor and OLED manufacturing sectors.
